'''2022 MPC Scott Lingrell LS MWYHL''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2022 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Scott Lingrell]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open MWYHL Lingrell LS 2022 MPC.txt |Download]]
